Other 2024 glossary entries were visually inspected but not forced where lexical variation is contextual or the precise preferred Unicode transcription is uncertain.
2024 reference does not establish 2号-only managerial terminology. No 2026 fact, time, temperature, concentration, process requirement or allergen count is changed.

Unresolved beyond the confirmed inventory: comprehensive normative choices for 5S, expiry labels, near-miss terminology and detailed safety-device terms require further contextual review.
